subject: Q3 Close: hygiene & commit lifecycle check (ApexCloud)
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Alex Kim <alex.kim@apexcloud.com>, Kelsey Torres <kelsey.t@apexcloud.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 Close: hygiene & commit lifecycle check (ApexCloud)

Team / ApexCloud,

We’re in the final sprint for Q3 and I want to lock visibility for the ApexCloud opportunity so finance can reflect committed revenue in tomorrow’s rollup. A few asks to tidy the pipeline and avoid last-minute changes: 

- Internal owners: please update HubSpot to the exact stage we agreed (Commit — PO Issued / Awaiting Signature) and add the expected PO delivery date in the close date field.
- ApexCloud: can you confirm the PO expectation (amount & approx arrival date)? If there are any final legal redlines we need to fast-track, flag them here.
- Attachments: I’ve attached a one-line rollup (Q3_commit_rollup.csv) and the latest SOW draft (ApexCloud_SOW_v3.pdf). If the SOW needs final wording, Kelsey / Alex please point us to the clause and we’ll prioritize.

Quick notes from my side: we are treating this as a firm commit for forecasting if PO is confirmed by EOD Thursday (2026-07-30). If PO slips past that, we will mark as ‘Deliverable > Pending’ for the daily forecast but remove from committed total.

Next steps (Owners):
- Ben: reconcile any outstanding discount approvals or billing exceptions with finance.
- Naomi: check billing calendar and ensure the invoice cadence matches the requested terms in the SOW.
- Marissa: refresh the close-rollup after HubSpot updates and share the snapshot link.

Thanks — I’ll collect confirmations in this thread so Finance has a single source of truth.

—
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0172

Subject: Re: Q3 Close: hygiene & commit lifecycle check (ApexCloud)

Sofia / team,

Thanks for the heads-up. Quick confirmation from us:
- ApexCloud intends to issue the PO for the base plan + dedicated support (USD 295,000) by Tue 2026-07-30 EOD.
- We have one internal legal comment on Section 6 (data residency appendix). Kelsey is looping legal this morning and will confirm if it’s a redline or a standard clause tweak.
- No changes requested to the SOW amount; we can accept the payment terms as drafted (net 30 after invoice).

I’ll upload the signed PO to the DocuSign envelope by EOD once legal clears the appendix. If there’s anything specific you need in the SOW to expedite sign-off, tell us now.

Regards,

ApexCloud, Inc.

Subject: Re: Q3 Close: hygiene & commit lifecycle check (ApexCloud)

Thanks Alex / Sofia — small operational notes from my side before we label as committed: 

1) Discounts & Approvals: This opportunity had a 10% promotional discount applied during negotiation. Legal pricing approval is on file but Finance requires a final approval ticket for revenue recognition at that discount. I’ll attach the approval ref in HubSpot by EOD.

2) Billing trigger: Naomi, can we confirm that the first invoice can be dated the day after PO receipt? If ApexCloud signs 7/30, we want to ensure the invoice can go out 7/31 to align with quarterly recognition.

3) HubSpot hygiene: I found the opportunity close date is still 2026-08-02 in the record — please update to 2026-07-30 to match PO arrival assumption. Also please add "PO in flight" to the internal notes and paste the DocuSign envelope ID once Alex uploads the PO.

I’m marking this as Commit-Conditional until PO appears in the envelope. Once PO is there, I’ll flip to Commit-Firm and notify Finance.

—
Ben Carter
Sales Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Kim <alex.kim@apexcloud.com>, Kelsey Torres <kelsey.t@apexcloud.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2026 09:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Close: hygiene & commit lifecycle check (ApexCloud)

Appreciate the quick responses. Final checklist before Finance snapshot at 10:30 PT: 

- Alex / Kelsey: please upload the PO to the DocuSign envelope and reply here with the envelope ID (or attach the signed PDF).
- Ben: once you see the DocuSign file, flip HubSpot stage to "Commit — PO Received" and add the approval ticket number.
- Naomi: tentatively plan to include this as committed revenue in the 11:00 rollup if stage is updated by 10:30 PT. If not, it will fall back to pending for the daily forecast.

I’ve attached the one-line rollup for the close team and the SOW we used in negotiations. I’ll post the final snapshot in #revops-forecast after 10:30.

If anything blocks PO delivery (legal redline that requires us to change commercial terms), escalate to me immediately and cc Finance so we can evaluate impact on recognition.

Thanks all — we should be able to close this in today’s commit window.

—
Sofia
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
